steps.title: Prepare the site
steps.text: Clear and level the ground where the ramp will sit, and mark out its footprint so you know exactly where everything goes.
steps.safety_tip: Call before you dig to check for buried utilities.

steps.title: Cut the stringers
steps.text: Cut the sloped stringers that carry the ramp. Each one gets a flat cut where it meets the ground and an angled cut at the top.
steps.safety_tip: Wear eye and ear protection while you cut.

steps.title: Cut the ledger
steps.text: Cut the ledger board that ties the top of the ramp to the porch.

steps.title: Attach the ledger
steps.text: Fasten the ledger to the porch, checking that it sits level before you drive the last screws.
steps.safety_tip: Make sure your ladder is on firm, level ground.

steps.title: Set the stringers
steps.text: Set the stringers evenly spaced, then fasten their top ends to the ledger.

steps.title: Check the slope
steps.text: Lay a level along a stringer and confirm the ramp is gentle enough before you add the decking.

steps.title: Install the decking
steps.text: Fasten the deck boards across the stringers, leaving a small even gap between them.

steps.title: Install the edge curbs
steps.text: Run a curb along each open edge so wheels and walker feet can't slip off the side.

steps.title: Install the handrail posts and rails
steps.text: Stand the posts and fasten a rail across the top of each row so someone can steady themselves.
steps.safety_tip: Push and pull on the finished rail to be sure it's solid before anyone leans on it.

steps.title: Final check
steps.text: Walk the whole ramp slowly, tighten any loose fasteners, and sand down any splinters.
